text: Si wanaa ɓen muññiiɓe e waawneede, e tottugol dewe ɗen, ɓe muññii e faggagol goopi, ɓe golli golle moƴƴe. Hino woodani ɓen ɗon alhaali goo, tawde taƴaare heɓataaɓe, wanah yeddugol neema Alla, wanaa kadi ñaaƴagol e yimɓe. Ɓen siforiiɓe ɗin sifaaji, hino woodani ɓe immorde ka Joomi maɓɓe, haforaneede junuubi, hino woodani ɓe kadi njoɓdi mawnundi ka laakara.
